digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, model escalation and context-window sizing
propositions: models_at_or_above(model) falls through to full-ladder fallback when model is not in Anthropic family substring list, returning unlocated primaries at same rung as the smallest models
largest_window_tokens(model) returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] (1000000) for unlocated non-Anthropic models, overstating the safe context window
escalation loop assigns returned ladder names directly to config, causing first escalation of nova primary to downgrade to claude-haiku-4-5 with different provider and smaller window
prerequisite escalation at prerequisites.py:260-263 has the same defect via models_at_or_above, jumping family and shrinking window when primary is unlocated

fix must return [model] from models_at_or_above for truthy-but-unlocated primary to preserve one-criterion retry, and min(MODEL_LADDER window) from largest_window_tokens to conservatively block oversized prompts
